discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and their quantized edge-state transport (quantum spin Hall and quantum anomalous Hall effects)

nominees.name: Qi-Kun Xue
nominees.affiliation: Southern University of Science and Technology and Tsinghua University, China

subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological phases of matter
motivation: Topological insulators established that band topology, encoded in Berry phases of Bloch electrons, defines a new class of electronic matter in real materials. Charles Kane (with E. Mele) introduced the Z2 topological invariant and the quantum spin Hall state, then with L. Fu extended it to three dimensions and gave practical criteria to identify real compounds. Laurens Molenkamp first observed quantized helical edge conduction in HgTe quantum wells (2007), the decisive experimental proof of a time-reversal-invariant topological phase. Qi-Kun Xue, through atomically controlled MBE growth of magnetic topological insulator films, achieved the quantum anomalous Hall effect (2013): quantized Hall resistance at zero magnetic field, a long-sought state predicted by Haldane's model. Together these works opened a field that now spans Weyl and Dirac semimetals, axion insulators and topological quantum devices, exemplifying the chain from abstract theory to materials realization and precise measurement.
